rules.title: Adopter carries another repository's governance instance.
rules.subject: .governance/required-checks.json
rules.remediation: Rewrite the instance for this repository: its own name, its own workflow file and the check names its own workflows publish. The seed is a starting point, not content to keep.

rules.title: A required check name is published by no workflow in this repository.
rules.subject: .governance/required-checks.json
rules.remediation: Either add the job that publishes the name, or declare the names the workflows already publish. A required check no workflow can produce blocks every pull request forever.

rules.title: A standard-managed file differs from the revision this repository pins.
rules.remediation: Adopt the pinned revision so managed files match their recorded digests, or repair the file. Managed content is not an extension point.

rules.title: A declared governance gate is invoked by no workflow.
rules.subject: project/governance-check.sh
rules.remediation: Invoke the gate from a workflow, or stop declaring it. A gate that never runs is documentation, and it reads as protection that is not there.
